facts.fact: An analyst's opinion piece of 22 October 2026 says Morocco's Bill 52-26 would make a shared medical record mandatory for facilities and professionals, with health identifiers and interconnected systems, and calls for a National Agency for the Digitization of the Healthcare System; the piece does not establish that the bill is adopted.

Morocco's Bill 52-26 sets out shared medical records, health identifiers and interoperability, requiring health systems to be interconnected, and the electronic treatment form is being rolled out with the national health insurer CNSS and integrated with the shared record, according to an analyst's piece of 22 October 2026.

MAR.note: The piece discusses a planned shared record and governance; it states no national health management information system procured, piloted or in service.
Bill 52-26 is a health-sector rule; it is not a government-wide framework for how government systems exchange data.
